mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ADMIN WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT g.GROUP_ID AS groupId, g.TITLE AS title, g.STATUS AS status, CASE WHEN g.OWNER_ID = #{memberId} THEN 'OWNER' ELSE 'MEMBER' END AS role FROM GYE_GROUP g WHERE g.OWNER_ID = #{memberId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM GYE_MEMBER gm WHERE gm.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND gm.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) ORDER BY g.GROUP_ID DESC
SELECT GROUP_ID AS groupId, TITLE AS title, STATUS AS status FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SUPPORT_REPORT ( SUPPORT_REPORT_ID, MEMBER_ID, GROUP_ID, CATEGORY, DETAIL_ENC, KEY_VER, STATUS, ADMIN_MEMO, HANDLED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{reportId}, #{memberId}, #{groupId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{category}, #{detailEnc, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{keyVer}, 'RECEIVED', NULL, NULL, SYSDATE, NULL )
mapper.sql: SELECT r.SUPPORT_REPORT_ID AS supportReportId, r.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.NAME AS reporterName, r.GROUP_ID AS groupId, g.TITLE AS groupTitle, r.CATEGORY AS category, r.DETAIL_ENC AS detailEnc, r.KEY_VER AS keyVer, r.STATUS AS status, r.ADMIN_MEMO AS adminMemo, r.HANDLED_BY AS handledBy, a.NAME AS handledByName, TO_CHAR(r.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(r.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM SUPPORT_REPORT r JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = r.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN GYE_GROUP g ON g.GROUP_ID = r.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON a.ADMIN_ID = r.HANDLED_BY
mapper.select: SELECT SUPPORT_REPORT_ID AS supportReportId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, GROUP_ID AS groupId, CATEGORY AS category, DETAIL_ENC AS detailEnc, KEY_VER AS keyVer, STATUS AS status, ADMIN_MEMO AS adminMemo, HANDLED_BY AS handledBy, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM SUPPORT_REPORT WHERE SUPPORT_REPORT_ID = #{reportId} FOR UPDATE
WHERE r.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC, r.SUPPORT_REPORT_ID DESC

AND r.STATUS = #{status}
ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC, r.SUPPORT_REPORT_ID DESC
SELECT STATUS AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SUPPORT_REPORT GROUP BY STATUS
mapper.update: UPDATE SUPPORT_REPORT SET STATUS = #{status}, ADMIN_MEMO = #{adminMemo}, HANDLED_BY = #{handledBy}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE SUPPORT_REPORT_ID = #{reportId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG ( AUDIT_LOG_ID, GROUP_ID, ACTOR_MEMBER_ID, ACTOR_ADMIN_ID, TARGET_MEMBER_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_AUDIT_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{groupId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{actorMemberId}, NULL, NULL, #{eventType}, #{description}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG ( AUDIT_LOG_ID, GROUP_ID, ACTOR_MEMBER_ID, ACTOR_ADMIN_ID, TARGET_MEMBER_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_AUDIT_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{groupId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NULL, #{actorAdminId}, #{targetMemberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{eventType}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT l.AUDIT_LOG_ID AS auditLogId, l.ACTOR_ADMIN_ID AS actorAdminId, a.NAME AS actorAdminName, l.DESCRIPTION AS description, TO_CHAR(l.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM AUDIT_LOG l LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON a.ADMIN_ID = l.ACTOR_ADMIN_ID WHERE l.EVENT_TYPE = 'REPORT_STATUS' AND l.DESCRIPTION LIKE 'REPORT #' || #{reportId} || ' · %' ORDER BY l.CREATED_AT DESC, l.AUDIT_LOG_ID DESC

SELECT l.AUDIT_LOG_ID AS auditLogId, l.ACTOR_ADMIN_ID AS actorAdminId, a.NAME AS actorAdminName, l.DESCRIPTION AS description, TO_CHAR(l.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM AUDIT_LOG l LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON a.ADMIN_ID = l.ACTOR_ADMIN_ID WHERE l.EVENT_TYPE = 'REPORT_STATUS' AND l.TARGET_MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY l.CREATED_AT DESC, l.AUDIT_LOG_ID DESC

SELECT l.AUDIT_LOG_ID AS auditLogId, l.ACTOR_ADMIN_ID AS actorAdminId, a.NAME AS actorAdminName, l.DESCRIPTION AS description, TO_CHAR(l.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM AUDIT_LOG l LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON a.ADMIN_ID = l.ACTOR_ADMIN_ID WHERE l.EVENT_TYPE = 'REPORT_STATUS'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SUPPORT_REPORT sr WHERE sr.STATUS = #{status} AND l.DESCRIPTION LIKE 'REPORT #' || sr.SUPPORT_REPORT_ID || ' · %' )
ORDER BY l.CREATED_AT DESC, l.AUDIT_LOG_ID DESC
